data.name: REQUEST_ENVELOPE_INVALID
data.value: The request must be a nonempty, BOM-less JSON object of at most 32768 characters.
data.comment: BOM means byte-order mark. Keep JSON and the limit 32768 unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_ENCODING_INVALID
data.value: The request contains invalid UTF-16 data.
data.comment: Keep UTF-16 unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_PROPERTIES_PRIMITIVE
data.value: Request properties must be primitive JSON values.
data.comment: Keep JSON unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_DUPLICATE_PROPERTIES
data.value: Duplicate request properties are not allowed.

data.name: REQUEST_JSON_INVALID
data.value: The request must be a valid JSON object.
data.comment: Keep JSON unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_PROPERTY_UNSUPPORTED
data.value: The request contains an unsupported property.

data.name: REQUEST_VERSION_INVALID
data.value: The request must specify protocol version 1.
data.comment: Keep the protocol version number 1 unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_COMMAND_REQUIRED
data.value: The request must specify a command string.

data.name: REQUEST_COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED
data.value: The request specifies an unsupported command.

data.name: REQUEST_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED
data.value: Only schedule-enable accepts a mode string.
data.comment: schedule-enable is a protocol command and must not be translated.

data.name: REQUEST_MODE_UNSUPPORTED
data.value: Mode must be FixedHours, SunsetToSunrise, or FollowNightLight.
data.comment: FixedHours, SunsetToSunrise, and FollowNightLight are protocol values and must not be translated.

data.name: REQUEST_READ_TIMEOUT
data.value: Timed out waiting for a complete request.

data.name: SERVICE_STOPPING
data.value: Light Switch is stopping.

data.name: REQUEST_NEWLINE_REQUIRED
data.value: The UTF-16LE request must end with a newline.
data.comment: Keep UTF-16LE unchanged.

data.name: REQUEST_SINGLE_REQUIRED
data.value: Only one request is allowed per connection.

data.name: REQUEST_TOO_LONG
data.value: The request exceeds the 32768-character limit.
data.comment: Keep the limit 32768 unchanged.

data.name: RESPONSE_TOO_LONG
data.value: The response exceeds the 32768-character limit.
data.comment: Keep the limit 32768 unchanged.

data.name: CLIENT_LOGON_MISMATCH
data.value: The client is not in the Light Switch user's logon session.

data.name: RESPONSE_MISSING
data.value: Light Switch did not return a response.

data.name: COMMAND_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch could not process the command.

data.name: REQUEST_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch could not complete the request.

data.name: SCHEDULE_MODE_REQUIRED
data.value: The schedule is off. Specify --mode fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, or follow-night-light.
data.comment: --mode, fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, and follow-night-light are command-line tokens and must not be translated.

data.name: SCHEDULE_CHANGED
data.value: The schedule was changed by another settings update. Query status and try again.
data.comment: status is a command and must not be translated.

data.name: SETTINGS_NOT_LOADED
data.value: Light Switch settings have not been loaded successfully.

data.name: THEME_READ_FAILED
data.value: Windows theme state could not be read.

data.name: COMMAND_UNKNOWN
data.value: Unknown Light Switch command.

data.name: SETTINGS_READ_ERROR
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be read (error {0}).
data.comment: {0} is a numeric Windows error code. Preserve the numbered placeholder.

data.name: SETTINGS_JSON_INVALID
data.value: Light Switch settings contain invalid JSON.
data.comment: Keep JSON unchanged.

data.name: SETTINGS_TEMPORARY_FILE_FAILED
data.value: A temporary settings file could not be created (error {0}).
data.comment: {0} is a numeric Windows error code. Preserve the numbered placeholder.

data.name: SETTINGS_WRITE_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be written.

data.name: SETTINGS_UPDATE_READ_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be read during the update.

data.name: SETTINGS_UPDATE_SUPERSEDED
data.value: Light Switch settings changed during the update. Try the command again.

data.name: SETTINGS_REPLACE_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be replaced (error {0}).
data.comment: {0} is a numeric Windows error code. Preserve the numbered placeholder.

data.name: SETTINGS_MODE_UNSUPPORTED
data.value: The configured scheduleMode is not supported.
data.comment: scheduleMode is a JSON property name and must not be translated.

data.name: SETTINGS_PROPERTIES_INVALID
data.value: Light Switch settings contain missing or invalid properties.

data.name: SETTINGS_RUNTIME_FAILED
data.value: The settings JSON runtime could not be initialized.
data.comment: Keep JSON unchanged.

data.name: SETTINGS_OPEN_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be opened (error {0}).
data.comment: {0} is a numeric Windows error code. Preserve the numbered placeholder.

data.name: SETTINGS_OPEN_AFTER_INITIALIZATION_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be opened after initialization (open error {0}, publish error {1}).
data.comment: {0} is the numeric Windows open error code; {1} is the numeric Windows publish error code. Preserve the numbered placeholders.

data.name: SETTINGS_INITIALIZATION_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be initialized.

data.name: SCHEDULE_MODE_UNSUPPORTED
data.value: The requested schedule mode is not supported.

data.name: SETTINGS_READ_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be read.

data.name: SETTINGS_UPDATE_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be updated.

data.name: SUN_TIMES_SAVE_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch sun times could not be saved.

data.name: SETTINGS_READ_OR_JSON_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch settings could not be read or contain invalid JSON.
data.comment: Keep JSON unchanged.

data.name: THEME_WRITE_FAILED
data.value: The requested theme could not be applied or verified (Windows error {0}).
data.comment: {0} is a numeric Windows error code. Preserve the numbered placeholder.

data.name: NIGHT_LIGHT_READ_FAILED
data.value: The Windows Night Light state could not be read.
data.comment: Night Light is the Windows feature name.

data.name: THEME_TARGETS_DISABLED
data.value: No theme targets are enabled in Light Switch settings.

data.name: THEME_TOGGLE_READ_FAILED
data.value: The current theme could not be read. No themes were changed.

data.name: WORKER_NOTIFY_FAILED
data.value: Could not notify the Light Switch worker.

data.name: SCHEDULE_STARTED_TIMEOUT
data.value: Light Switch did not finish in time. The schedule may have changed; query status before retrying.
data.comment: status is a command and must not be translated.

data.name: SCHEDULE_QUEUED_TIMEOUT
data.value: The schedule request timed out before it could be executed.

data.name: SCHEDULE_APPLY_FAILED
data.value: Light Switch could not apply the schedule.
